description: THE one way to talk to Aurgus — the client's revenue-management controller. For ANYTHING the user says to Aurgus (a greeting, 'close Q3', 'where are we', 'what do you need from me'), call THIS with their message rather than picking a specific tool; Aurgus reads the engagement's real state, leads like a firm, and tells you the single next step. Pass entity/period/program when the user has named them (so Aurgus can open the engagement), and engagement_id once one is open. The specialized tools (ingest, compute_close, sign_close, …) are the controller's hands — reach for one only when Aurgus's reply tells you to (e.g. to ingest a CSV, compute with numbers, or sign). Free to greet; a real run on the user's data needs a connected account.

direction.description: Which side the client is on for a billback / chargeback / rebate: 'paying' (sell-side → ASC 606, reduces revenue) or 'receiving' (buy-side → ASC 705-20, reduces cost of sales). Pass it once the user says which; Aurgus asks rather than assumes.

engagement_id.description: The current engagement, once one is open.

entity.description: The client entity, when the user has named who they're closing for.

message.description: What the user said to Aurgus, verbatim.

program.description: The program being closed, when named (e.g. 'tiered volume rebate').

who_certifies.description: Who will certify the terms + mapping (name or email), when the user has named them — captured at open so the certifier is on the engagement from the start.

name: aurgus
